category_title: Preschool girls performing meanness and aggression through 'sassy girl' play routines
scenario_title: Playground physical aggression and covert resistance
minimal_context: Kiara is playing outdoors on the playground with peers and a large plastic bat.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kiara, I saw you hitting the other children with that large plastic bat. Hitting is not allowed on the playground.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: We are not being mean. We are just playing mean girls.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You still need to follow the rules. Please put the bat in the bin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws the bat in the bin) I don’t want to go in our castle. Come on Kim Bear ... let’s go.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Where are you two going to play now?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Swings her hand toward you in mock aggression, curls up her fingers waving them mockingly, and then forcefully but covertly pulls a younger peer's arm down, keeping it out of your gaze)
